map.由公差带与测量标准差求测量能力指数 使用指南: Measurement capability index from tolerance band and measurement standard deviation guide
map.输入被测特性的上规格限 USL、下规格限 LSL 与测量过程标准差 s，按 Cg: Enter the upper specification limit USL, lower specification limit LSL and the standard deviation s of the measurement process, and compute the measurement capability index by Cg = (USL - LSL) / (6 x s). Used to judge whether the gauge resolution meets the tolerance requirement (generally Cg >= 1.33).
map.输入上/下规格限与测量标准差 s，求 Cg。: Enter the upper/lower specification limits and the measurement standard deviation s to get Cg.
map.：Cg = (USL-LSL)/(6*sigma_measure)（或 0.2*: : Cg = (USL - LSL)/(6*sigma_measure) (or the 0.2*(USL - LSL) constrained form). Example: tolerance 0.1, sigma_m = 0.008 gives Cg = 0.1/(6 x 0.008) = 2.08.
map.：Cg=(8−2)/(6×0.25)=4.000，远高于 1.33 的门槛，说明: : Cg = (8 - 2)/(6 x 0.25) = 4.000, well above the 1.33 threshold, meaning the gauge resolving power is more than adequate for this tolerance band.
